book.title: An Example Book
book.subtitle: How the Schema Works
book.extraction_note: Illustrative sample. The real idea_bank/ is kept local (see README).

ideas.headline: One idea per record, tagged by theme
ideas.principle: Each idea is a self-contained unit: a headline, a short principle in the author's spirit, and a concrete example. Themes are a list because a single idea can legitimately belong to more than one track.
ideas.author_example: The author illustrates this with a story about X, showing how the principle plays out in practice rather than in the abstract.

ideas.headline: Actionable ideas carry an extra field
ideas.principle: Ideas on 'actionable' themes (leadership, parenting) include an actionable_insight. The sender only renders that block when the day's register is 'actionable', so conceptual days stay reflective.
ideas.author_example: Where the author gives a specific drill or checklist, that becomes the actionable insight.
ideas.actionable_insight: Do one small, concrete thing today that tests the idea — then note what happened.
